verdict.rationale: Azure RBAC docs confirm fine-grained, resource-level access management (assign different roles per resource type/user) and managed identities for credential-free access, which is core least-privilege infrastructure. However, the evidence pack never mentions Azure ABAC conditions, detailed scope hierarchy (management group/subscription/resource group/resource), or documented policy evaluation logic (deny vs allow precedence), leaving the story's specific requirements only partially covered. Missing for 10: condition-based (ABAC) policy examples, explicit resource-level scoping documentation, and documented policy evaluation order/precedence, plus independent/hands-on corroboration.
